settings.headline: Numbing cream for lip fillers
settings.subhead: Numbing cream for lip fillers is a topical preparation applied beforehand to make the appointment more comfortable — it reduces the sensation rather than removing it. The lip is a sensitive area, so many people find numbing helps, though most practitioners apply their own as standard and often mix a numbing agent into the filler itself.

settings.headline: Numbing cream and gel for lip fillers
What to know
settings.body: Lip filler usually involves a sharp scratch and some pressure as the product is placed, eased by the numbing most practitioners use. If you're preparing at home, with your practitioner's agreement, a gel suits the lip well because it stays where it's placed; a cream works for broader areas. Numbing is preparation for comfort, applied to clean skin before your appointment and removed before treatment — it isn't part of the procedure. Because clinics differ, check what yours would like you to do first.

• Numbing for lip fillers is applied beforehand to reduce discomfort; it doesn't remove all sensation.
  • The lip is sensitive, so the scratch and pressure are brief but noticeable.
  • Most practitioners numb as standard and often use filler containing a numbing agent — check before preparing your own.
  • Senseless is a UK cosmetic numbing range, formulated in the United Kingdom — not a medicine.

settings.question: Can you use numbing cream before lip fillers?
settings.answer: Often yes, for comfort — but most practitioners numb the lips themselves and may prefer you don't apply your own, so check first.

settings.question: What's the best numbing cream for lip fillers?
settings.answer: A gel suits the lip because it stays in place; a cream suits broader areas. Your practitioner can advise what's appropriate for your appointment.

settings.question: Does it hurt to get lip filler with numbing?
settings.answer: Numbing reduces the discomfort rather than removing it — most people describe a brief scratch and pressure.

settings.question: Is numbing cream safe before lip filler?
settings.answer: Used as directed on clean, healthy skin it's widely used; patch test first and check with your practitioner.
